artifact_observations.location: Right side of the image, specifically the blue object and background
artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant motion blur or out-of-focus blur affects the right half of the image, making the blue structure indistinct. This looks like a camera artifact rather than AI generation, but degrades quality.
The spines of the books lack sharp text definition and appear slightly 'smudged' or painterly, which could be due to low resolution/compression or mild AI texture inconsistency.
Slight keystone distortion suggests the photo was taken at an angle without correction, causing vertical lines to converge slightly. Not an AI artifact, but a geometric property.
